clips.title: The story
paras: Neeru Fireblade has earned your trust, and Thrall awaits your report in Orgrimmar. The Warchief needs to know how far the Burning Blade's reach extends across Kalimdor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You are one of my lieutenants! Prepare yourself, adventurer. I will call upon you soon.

My time spent on the Searing Blade may be all but wasted now, but that does not mean that the Shadow Council's schemes elsewhere must suffer. I will do what I can to minimize the damage here in Ragefire Chasm. In the meantime, I will have my agents in the Barrens and Ashenvale begin work on our newest agenda. Return to me soon.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ashenvale? Hmm, I had not heard of any presence of the Council or the Burning Blade in Ashenvale. My spies will investigate, friend. You have done well.
For now, rest, and keep yourself occupied with other tasks. I will call upon you again soon.
